entries.description: Curated map of texuli.com for language models: getting started, guides, component families, primitives, themes and the agent surfaces, as Markdown links.
representativeQueries: what is Texuli and what can I build with it
give me a map of the Texuli component families
how do Texuli web components relate to the Kotlin renderer

entries.displayName: Texuli Full Content Corpus for LLMs
entries.description: Expanded llms.txt corpus with the catalog's component documentation for retrieval and grounding. Every docs page also has a Markdown twin at the same path plus .md (guides/theming.md beside guides/theming/).
representativeQueries: read the full Texuli component documentation for grounding
fetch the Markdown twin of the Button component page

entries.description: The llms bundle index over one pre-rendered Markdown document per catalog component (133 today), each also served standalone at /llms/components/<id>.md.
representativeQueries: list every Texuli component with its llms doc
open the llms doc for the dialog component

entries.description: The agent catalog snapshot: every component manifest with props, variants, examples, a11y notes and keyboard interactions — the data the sink-free renderer consumes. A README beside it names the content hash.
capabilities: a11y and keyboard documentation per component
representativeQueries: fetch the Texuli catalog snapshot as JSON
what props does the Texuli button component accept

entries.description: RFC 9727 API catalog linkset pointing at the site's service documentation (llms.txt), the catalog snapshot, the component docs bundle and the skill.
representativeQueries: where is the API catalog for texuli.com
find the service documentation for Texuli

entries.description: Agent Skills Discovery index listing every SKILL.md in the Texuli skill pack — the router and each sub-skill — served with the pack itself under /skill-pack/ and pinned by SHA-256 digest.
representativeQueries: which agent skills does texuli.com publish
show the agent skills discovery index for Texuli

entries.description: The distributable Texuli skill, served raw: a router that teaches coding agents to build with Texuli (components, themes, media, blueprints, contribution). Offline and install-free to read; the /skill/ page documents per-host installation and checksums.
representativeQueries: read the Texuli skill router for coding agents
how do I install the Texuli skill in my coding agent

entries.description: The Texuli package on npm (prerelease dist-tag next): styled components built on owned primitives, tokens and the agent catalog. Fourteen scoped @texuli/* packages ship alongside it.
